paragraphs.text: And in the seventh week in the first year [1317 A.M.] thereof, in this jubilee, Noah planted vines on the mountain on which the ark had rested, named Lubar, one of the Ararat Mountains, and they produced fruit in the fourth year, [1320 A.M.] and he guarded their fruit, and gathered it in this year in the And he made wine therefrom and put it into a vessel, and kept it until year, [1321 A.M.] until the first day, on the new moon of the first month.
paragraphs.original: ወበ፫ ሰቡዕ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ተከለ፡ ኖኅ፡ ወይነ፡ በደብር፡ ዘሎቱ፡ ስሙ፡ ሉብር፡ እምነ፡ አድባር፡ ዘአራራት፡ ኀበ፡ ቆመት፡ ታቦት፡ ወአፍረየ፡ ፍሬ፡ በራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-3 sabuʿ la-zəntu ʾiyobēləwu takala Noḫ wayna ba-dabr zalottu səmu Lubar ʾəm-nə ʾadbār zaʾArārāt ḫaba qomat tābot wa-ʾafraya fəre ba-rābəʿ ʿāmat

paragraphs.text: celebrated with joy the day of this feast, and he made a burnt sacrifice unto the Lord, one young ox and one ram, and seven sheep, each a year old, and a kid of the goats, that he might make atonement thereby for himself And he prepared the kid first, and placed some of its blood on the flesh that was on the altar which he had made, and all the fat he laid on the altar where he made the burnt sacrifice, and the ox and the ram and the sheep, and he laid all their flesh upon the altar.
paragraphs.original: ወዐቀቦ፡ እስከ፡ ዓመት፡ ኃምስ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ለዕለተ፡ በዓል፡ ወአፍረየ፡ ፍሬ፡ ምልዕተ፡ ለመሥዋዕት፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚእ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ዘሰብዐ፡ ላሕም፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ዘሐነጾ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʿaqabō ʾəska ʿāmat ḫāməs la-zəntu sabuʿ la-ʿəlata baʿāl wa-ʾafraya fəre mələʿta la-maśwāʿt qədma ʾəgziʾ lāʿla məśwāʿ qadāmāwi zasabʿa lāḥm lāʿla məśwāʿ zaḥanaḍo

paragraphs.text: placed all their offerings mingled with oil upon it, and afterwards he sprinkled wine on the fire which he had previously made on the altar, and he placed incense on the altar and caused a sweet ascend acceptable before the Lord his God.
paragraphs.original: ወአዕረገ፡ ዐምድ፡ ዐርዘ፡ ጼዓዳ፡ በውስቴቱ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ወሥዋዐ፡ ሐዱደ፡ ዘላሕም፡ ወአዕረገ፡ ደሞ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ላዕለ፡ መጠረተ፡ ሥርቀተ፡ ዘፍሬሁ፡ ለመጠን፡ ዕጣን፡ ወቅዱስ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾaʿraga ʿaməd ʿarza ṣēʿādā ba-wəstētu lāʿla məśwāʿ wa-śwāʿa ḥaddudē zalāḥm wa-ʾaʿraga damo lāʿla məśwāʿ lāʿla maṭarata śərqata zafərehu la-maṭan ʿəṭān wa-qəddusə

paragraphs.text: And he rejoiced and drank of this wine, he children with joy. And it was evening, and he went into his tent, and being drunken he and slept, and was uncovered in his tent as he slept. And Ham saw Noah his father went forth and told his two brethren without.
paragraphs.original: ወአዕረገ፡ ኵሎ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ወወደየ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብር፡ ጼዐደ፡ ወባሕተ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለመሐራቅ፡ ለፀዳይ፡ ዘመዓዛ፡ ሠናይ፡ ዘይትፈቀር፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚእ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾaʿraga kwəlo maśwāʿta lāʿla məśwāʿ wa-wadaya lāʿla kwəlu gəbər ṣēʿada wa-bāḥta lottu la-maḥarāq la-ḍaday zamaʿāzā śannāy zayətfaqqar qədma ʾəgziʾ

paragraphs.text: And Shem took his garment and arose, he and Japheth, and they placed the garment on their shoulders and went backward and covered the of their father, and their faces were backward. And Noah awoke from his sleep and knew all that his younger son had done unto him, and he cursed his son and said: 'Cursed be enslaved servant shall he be unto his brethren.'
paragraphs.original: ወአፍሰሰ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ዘወይን፡ ወዘዘይት፡ ላዕለ፡ ቍርባን፡ ወአዕረገ፡ ዕፃተ፡ ላዕለ፡ እሳት፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ወቆርበቶ፡ ለዘይት፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾafsasa lāʿla məśwāʿ zawayən wa-zazaytə lāʿla qurbān wa-ʾaʿraga ʿəḍāta lāʿla ʾəsāt lāʿlēhu wa-qorbato la-zaytə lāʿla məśwāʿ

paragraphs.text: And he blessed Shem, and said: Lord God of Shem, and Canaan shall be his servant. God shall enlarge Japheth, and dwell in the dwelling of Shem, and Canaan shall be his servant.' And Ham knew that his father had cursed his younger son, and he was displeased that he had cursed his son. and he his father, he and his sons with him, Cush and Mizraim and Put and Canaan.
paragraphs.original: ወእምድኅረዝ፡ ሰትዩ፡ ኢሙንቱ፡ በውእቱ፡ ደብር፡ ወአቀመ፡ ኖኅ፡ በዓላተ፡ ለዘርዑ፡ ለፍሥሐ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ፡ ለእግዚእ፡ በዓመት፡ ለ፫ ሰቡዕ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmdəḫrazə satyu ʾəmuntu ba-wəʾtu dabr wa-ʾaqama Noḫ baʿālāta la-zarʿu la-fəśḥā qədmēhomu la-ʾəgziʾ ba-ʿāmat la-3 sabuʿ

paragraphs.text: himself a city and called its name after the name of his wife Ne'elatama'uk. Japheth saw it, and became envious of his brother, and he too built for himself a city, and he called its name after the name of his wife 'Adataneses.
paragraphs.original: ወሰትየ፡ ኖኅ፡ እምነ፡ ወይኑ፡ ወሰክረ፡ ወአዕረፈ፡ በማእከለ፡ ድንኳኑ፡ ወዕሩቅ፡ ይከውን፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-satya Noḫ ʾəm-nə waynu wa-sakra wa-ʾaʿrafa ba-māʾkala dənkwānu wa-ʿəruq yəkawwən

paragraphs.text: And Shem dwelt with his father Noah, and he built a city close to his father on the mountain, and he too called its name after the name of his wife And behold these three cities are near Mount Lubar; Sedeqetelebab fronting the east; and Na'eltama'uk on the south; 'Adatan'eses towards the west.
paragraphs.original: ወርእዮ፡ ሐም፡ ለኖኅ፡ አቡሁ፡ ዕሩቀ፡ ወወፅአ፡ ወዜነዎሙ፡ ለ፪ አኀዊሁ፡ ለአፍኣ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-rəʾəyo Ḥam la-Noḫ ʾabbuhu ʿəruqa wa-waḍʾa wa-zēnnawomu la-2 ʾəḫawihu la-ʾafʾā

paragraphs.text: And these are the sons of Shem: Elam, and Asshur, and Arpachshad -this (son) was born two years after the flood- The sons of Japheth: Gomer and Magog and Madai and Javan, Tubal Meshech and Tiras: these are the sons of Noah.
paragraphs.original: ወነሥአ፡ ሴም፡ ልብሰ፡ ወአንሥአ፡ ወቀመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወያፌት፡ ወአልበስዎ፡ ለአቡሆሙ፡ እንዘ፡ ይትገሐሡ፡ ድኅረ፡ ወይከድኑ፡ ሐፍረቶ፡ ለአቡሆሙ፡ ወገጾሙ፡ ድኅረ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-naśʾa Sēm ləbsa wa-ʾansəʾa wa-qoma wəʾtu wa-Yāfet wa-ʾalbasəwo la-ʾabbuhomu ʾənza yətgaḥaśu dəḫra wa-yəkadnu ḥafrato la-ʾabbuhomu wa-gaṣṣomu dəḫra

paragraphs.text: And in the twenty-eighth jubilee [1324-1372 A.M.] Noah began to enjoin upon his sons' sons the ordinances and commandments, and all the judgments that he knew, and he exhorted his sons to observe righteousness, and to cover the shame of their flesh, and to bless their Creator, and honour father and mother, and love their neighbour, and guard their souls from fornication and uncleanness and all iniquity.
paragraphs.original: ወአንቅሐ፡ ኖኅ፡ እምነ፡ ወይኑ፡ ወአእመረ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘገብሩ፡ ሎቱ፡ ደቂቁ፡ ወረገሞ፡ ለወልዱ፡ ወይቤ፡ ርጉም፡ ከንዓን፡ ገብረ፡ ገበር፡ ይኩን፡ ለአኀዊሁ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾanqəḥa Noḫ ʾəm-nə waynu wa-ʾaʾəmara kwəlu zagabru lottu daqiqu wa-ragagamo la-waldu wa-yəbē rəgum Kanʿān gabra gabar yəkun la-ʾəḫawihu

paragraphs.text: For owing to these three things came the flood upon the earth, namely, owing to the fornication wherein the Watchers against the law of their ordinances went a whoring after the daughters of men, and took themselves wives of all chose: and they made the beginning of uncleanness.
paragraphs.original: ወባረኮ፡ ለሴም፡ ወይቤ፡ ቡሩክ፡ እግዚእ፡ አምላከ፡ ሴም፡ ወይኩን፡ ከንዓን፡ ገብሮሙ፡ ወያሥፍሕ፡ እግዚእ፡ ለያፌት፡ ወይኅድር፡ ውስተ፡ ድንኳነ፡ ሴም፡ ወይኩን፡ ከንዓን፡ ገብሮሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-bārakō la-Sēm wa-yəbē buruk ʾəgziʾ ʾamlāka Sēm wa-yəkun Kanʿān gabromu wa-yāśfəḥ ʾəgziʾ la-Yāfet wa-yəḫdər wəsta dənkwāna Sēm wa-yəkun Kanʿān gabromu

paragraphs.text: And they begat sons the Naphidim, and they were all unlike, and they devoured one another: and the Giants slew the Naphil slew the Eljo, and the Eljo mankind, and one man another. And every one sold to work iniquity and to shed much blood, and the earth was filled with iniquity.
paragraphs.original: ወከንዐንሰ፡ ኢተአተወ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ አላ፡ ቦአ፡ ምድረ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ እምነ፡ ዮርዳኖስ፡ እስከ፡ ግብጽ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ አርያውያን፡ ወአልዘበ፡ ምድረ፡ በዓቅም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-Kanʿānsa ʾi-taʾatawa məslēhu ʾallā boʾa mədra Libānos ʾəm-nə Yordānos ʾəska Gəbṣ kwəlomu ʾaryāwəyān wa-ʾalzaba mədra ba-ʿaqəm

paragraphs.text: after this they sinned against the beasts and birds, and all that moves and walks on the earth: and much blood was shed on the earth, and every imagination and desire of men imagined vanity and And the Lord destroyed everything from off the face of the earth; because of the wickedness of their deeds, and because of the blood which they had shed in the midst of the He destroyed everything.
paragraphs.original: ወይቤሎ፡ ሐም፡ አቡሁ፡ ወካም፡ ወያፌት፡ አኀዊሁ፡ አንተ፡ ሰሐትከ፡ በምድር፡ ዘአኮ፡ መክፈልትከ፡ ወአኮ፡ በተወልዶ፡ ለነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሥርዐት፡ ላዕሌከ፡ ርጉም፡ አንተ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəbēlo Ḥam ʾabbuhu wa-Kām wa-Yāfet ʾəḫawihu ʾanta saḥatka ba-mədr za-ʾakko makfaltka wa-ʾakko ba-tawaldo lana mawāʿəla śərʿat lāʿlēka rəgum ʾanta

paragraphs.text: 'And we were left, I and you, my sons, and everything that entered with us into the ark, and behold I see your works before me that ye do not walk in righteousness: for in the path of destruction ye have begun to walk, and ye are parting one from another, and are envious one of another, and (so it comes) that ye are not in harmony, my sons, each with his brother.
paragraphs.original: ወአንተ፡ ኢሰማዕከ፡ ቃለነ፡ ወአፅሐድከ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ወውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ዘአኮ፡ መክፈልትከ፡ ሰፈርከ፡ በእንተዝ፡ ርጉም፡ አንተ፡ ወትከውን፡ ርጉመ፡ ኵሎ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾanta ʾi-samaʿka qālana wa-ʾaḍḥadka śərʿata wa-wəsta mədr za-ʾakko makfaltka safarka ba-ʾəntazə rəgum ʾanta wa-təkawwən rəguma kwəlu daqiqa sabʾ

paragraphs.text: For I see, and behold the demons have begun (their) seductions against you and against your children and now I fear on your behalf, that after my death ye will shed the blood of men and that ye, too, will be destroyed from the face of the earth.
paragraphs.original: ወአንቀጸ፡ ኖኅ፡ በውእቱ፡ ደብር፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ወአዘዞሙ፡ በብሕታዊት፡ ለልሕናጻዊ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾanqaḍa Noḫ ba-wəʾtu dabr śərʿata la-daqiqu wa-ʾazazomu ba-bəḥtāwit la-ləḥnāḍāwi

paragraphs.text: For whoso sheddeth man's blood, and whoso eateth the blood of any flesh, shall all be destroyed from the earth. And there shall not be left any man that eateth blood, or that sheddeth the blood of man on the earth, Nor shall there be left to him any seed or descendants living under heaven; For into Sheol shall they go, And into the place of condemnation shall they descend, And into the darkness of the deep shall they all be removed by a violent death.
paragraphs.original: ወወለደ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለኖኅ፡ ወልደ፡ ራብዐ፡ ድኅረ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኪዳን፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ናፍ፡ እስመ፡ ይቤ፡ ናፍ፡ ፈረየ፡ ሊተ፡ እግዚእ፡ ድኅረ፡ ማየ፡ አይኅ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-walada lottu la-Noḫ walda rābəʿa dəḫra zəntu kidān wa-samayō səmō Nāf ʾəsma yəbē Nāf faraya lita ʾəgziʾ dəḫra māya ʾāyəḫ

paragraphs.text: There shall be no blood seen upon you of all the blood there shall be all the days in which ye have killed any beasts or cattle or whatever flies upon the earth, and work ye a good souls by covering that which has been shed on the face of the earth.
paragraphs.original: ወወለደ፡ ሴም፡ ለ፭ ደቂቅ፡ ኤላም፡ ወአሱር፡ ወአርፋክሰድ፡ ወአራም፡ ወሊዶ፡ ወወለደ፡ ሐም፡ ለ፬ ደቂቅ፡ ኩሽ፡ ወምስር፡ ወፉጥ፡ ወከንዓን፡ ወወለደ፡ ያፌት፡ ለ፯ ደቂቅ፡ ጎሜር፡ ወማጎጎ፡ ወማዳይ፡ ወያዋን፡ ወቱባል፡ ወሞሰሐ፡ ወቲራስ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-walada Sēm la-5 daqiq ʾElām wa-ʾAsur wa-ʾArfaksad wa-ʾArām wa-Liddo wa-walada Ḥam la-4 daqiq Kuš wa-Məsr wa-Fuṭ wa-Kanʿān wa-walada Yāfet la-7 daqiq Gomer wa-Magog wa-Māday wa-Yāwān wa-Tubāl wa-Mosaḥ wa-Tirās

paragraphs.text: And ye shall not be like him who eats with blood, but guard yourselves that none may eat blood before you: cover for thus have I been commanded to testify to you and your children, together with all And suffer not the soul to be eaten with the flesh, that your blood, which is your life, may at the hand of any flesh that sheds (it) on the earth.
paragraphs.original: ወበፍጻሜ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ዘ፴ ጸውዐ፡ ኖኅ፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ውሉዶሙ፡ ወአኀዘ፡ ይዕዘዞሙ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘያአምር፡ ወአስምዐ፡ ላዕለ፡ ደቂቁ፡ ከመ፡ ይዕቀቡ፡ ጽድቀ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-fəṣṣāmē ʾiyobēləwu za-30 ṣawʿa Noḫ la-daqiqu wəludomu wa-ʾaḫaza yəʿzəzomu śərʿata kwəlo zayāʾammər wa-ʾasmaʿa lāʿla daqiqu kama yəʿqabu ṣədqa

paragraphs.text: For the earth will not be clean from the blood which has been shed upon it; for (only) through the blood of him that shed it will the purified throughout all its generations. And now, my children, harken: work judgment and righteousness that ye maybe planted in righteousness over the face of the whole earth, and glory lifted up before my God, who saved me from the waters of the flood.
paragraphs.original: ወአስምዐ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ወአዘዞሙ፡ ከመ፡ ይግበሩ፡ ጽድቀ፡ ወከመ፡ ይክድኑ፡ ሐፍረተ፡ ሥጋሆሙ፡ ወከመ፡ ይባርኩ፡ ለፈጣሪሆሙ፡ ወከመ፡ ያክብሩ፡ አበ፡ ወእመ፡ ወከመ፡ ያፍቅሩ፡ ቢጾሙ፡ ወከመ፡ ይዕቀቡ፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ እምነ፡ ዝሙት፡ ወእምነ፡ ርኵስ፡ ወእምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዐመፃ፡

paragraphs.text: behold, ye will go and build for yourselves cities, and plant in them all the plants that are upon the earth, and moreover all fruit-bearing trees. For three years the fruit of everything that is eaten will not be gathered: and in the fourth year its fruit will be accounted holy [and they will offer the first-fruits], acceptable before the Most High God, who created heaven and earth and all things.
paragraphs.original: እስመ፡ በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ መጽአ፡ አይኅ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ እስመ፡ ዘመው፡ ወእስመ፡ አርኰሱ፡ ምድረ፡ ወእስመ፡ ግፍዕ፡ ኮነ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: ʾəsma ba-ʾənta zəntu śalastu maṣʾa ʾāyəḫ lāʿla mədr ʾəsma zammawu wa-ʾəsma ʾarkwasu mədra wa-ʾəsma gəfʿa kona lāʿla mədr

paragraphs.text: Let them offer in abundance the first of the wine and oil (as) first-fruits on the altar of the Lord, who receives it, and what is left let the servants of the house of the Lord eat before the altar which receives And in the fifth year make ye the release so that ye release it in righteousness and uprightness, and ye shall be and all that you plant shall prosper.
paragraphs.original: እስመ፡ ዘመው፡ ትጉሃን፡ ምስለ፡ አንስት፡ ወአንስት፡ እምነ፡ ዘፈቀዱ፡ ይቤዙ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወአኀዙ፡ ይትሐናኰው፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ ወወለዱ፡ ሎሙ፡ ውሉደ፡ ወውእቶሙ፡ ሀለዉ፡ ኄሊያን፡
paragraphs.translit: ʾəsma zammawu Təguhānə məsla ʾanəst wa-ʾanəst ʾəm-nə zafaqadu yəbēzu kiyāhomu wa-ʾaḫazu yətḥanāwwə məslēhomu wa-waladu lomu wəluda wa-wəʾətomu hallawu Ḥeliyān

paragraphs.text: For thus did Enoch, the father of your father command Methuselah, his son, and Methuselah his son Lamech, and Lamech commanded me all which his fathers commanded him. And I also will give you commandment, my sons, as Enoch commanded his son in the first jubilees: whilst still living, the seventh in his generation, he commanded and testified to his son and to his son's sons until the day of his death.'
paragraphs.original: ወወለዱ፡ ኄሊያን፡ ለናፊል፡ ወአልጨቅ፡ ቆሙ፡ ኵሉ፡ እምነ፡ ካልኡ፡ በመጠን፡ ኂሩቶሙ፡ ወያቴሥቅሉ፡ አሐዱ፡ ካልኦ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-waladu Ḥeliyān la-Nāfil wa-ʾalṣaqq qomu kwəlu ʾəm-nə kāləʾu ba-maṭan ḥirutomu wa-yātēśqəlu ʾaḥadu kāləʾo
